newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Moody's may downgrade Foster's rating.
newsitem.headline: Moody's may downgrade Foster's rating.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Friday it was reviewing Foster's Brewing Group Ltd's Baa1 senior debt rating for a possible downgrade after Foster's announcement of a capital restructure.
Foster's announced on Thursday it planned a A$625 million share buy-back of 13.0 percent of Foster's shares held by Asahi Breweries Ltd's from cash flows and existing lines of debt.
"Funding for the share buy-back will have a lage debt component and will increase leverage to 70 percent," Moody's said.

"Moody's review will focus on the level of financial risk inherent in Foster's ongoing efforts to enhance shareholder returns, the company's appetite for future acquisitions, and the stability of earnings and cash flow generated by its existing beer and wine businesses," Moody's said.
